## About
Ariel Jimenez is the founder and CEO of Triumph A/C & Refrigeration Corp. In the early days he was the sole installer and support representative for the whole company, and he grew it little by little. Today he still stays involved in every project.
We serve both residential and commercial customers throughout the state of Florida, from new installs for new construction to routine service. As we put it ourselves, it is important to us to give honest advice and excellent service above all else.
Reviewers mention the people by name: Ariel, Roberto and Carlos in the field, Eileen on the phone, and William and Christian on install day. Our customers rate us 4.6 on Google from 34 reviews.

## Services
- Installations: Upgrading to a modern AC system or putting a brand-new install into new construction. We help you pick the right system and install it properly.
- Repair: If your AC has stopped, slowed or is just not keeping up, our team will find the source of the problem and get it running again.
- Maintenance: Preventative maintenance is an easy, economical way to keep your system running smoothly all year round.
- Duct Cleaning: Dirty ducts drag down the efficiency of the whole system. Cleaning them helps keep it working the way it should.
- Tune-Up: Convenient maintenance programs to keep your system in good shape.
- Air Filtration Solution: A good indoor air quality system helps keep your family healthy as well as comfortable.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Give us a call and ask our specialists for a free estimate.

Q: Can I finance a new AC system?
A: Yes. We offer in-house financing for air conditioner installation.

Q: Do you work on homes and businesses?
A: Both. We serve residential and commercial customers throughout the state of Florida.

Q: Which brands do you work on?
A: We have extensive experience working on all major brands.
